title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount

Attacks on shipping are rising, and efforts to stop a return to full-scale fighting have yet to produce a deal. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the threat to regional and maritime security. Follow live below – and for full meetings coverage year

title: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay

title: COP31 opens in Antalya: Can climate promises finally deliver results?

With a powerful El Niño threatening to worsen extreme weather, negotiators face difficult questions over climate finance, clean energy and how to protect communities already living with the consequences of climate change.
